rules.tokenization: lowercase ASCII [a-z0-9]+; existing STOP set; no stemming or synonyms
rules.acceptance: score > 0 only; no semantic support check
rules.baseline: unique query/document token intersection count on the same title + text, STOP set, positive-score filter and source-ID ties

evaluation.authoring: Freeze registry, Python/browser retrieval, comparator and evaluator first. Author and label all questions before either method runs. Seal the manifest and complete questions before evaluation; do not tune rules or labels on outcomes.
evaluation.source_recall: Answerable questions only: a labelled acceptable source appears at rank 1 or in the first 3 results.
evaluation.source_misses: Answerable questions only at each cutoff: expected source absent; partition into empty retrieval and nonempty wrong-source retrieval. Hits plus misses equal the answerable denominator.
evaluation.false_support: Unsupported questions only: any nonempty retrieval, a retrieval-as-support risk proxy, not entailment or generated-answer error.
evaluation.empty_retrieval: Report separately for answerable and unsupported questions and each unsupported stratum.
evaluation.independence: A new source-aware authored wave, distinct from earlier questions and independent of retrieval parameter selection. Earlier results were visible; no blinded annotator or representative user sampling is claimed.
evaluation.costs: Both methods use the same saved title/text and return at most three records. No runtime, operation-count or infrastructure cost advantage is measured.
